column2: POS na gidan abinci · kyauta har abada
Cinkoson abincin rana. Babu intanet. Babu matsala.
Khaynjo yana gudanar da falonku, kicin da teburin ciniki a kan na’urorin da kuke da su tuni — daga tebur zuwa kicin zuwa lissafi, da intanet ko babu.
Android a Google Play yanzu · manhajojin Windows da Linux suna nan tafe.
Yana aiki ba tare da intanet ba
Taɓa tebur don bin sa cikin ziyara ɗaya. Launuka da kalmomi iri ɗaya da na manhajar — kuma tebur ba ya zama babu kowa sai an biya.

Shahararren abinci ɗaya daga kowace ƙasa — sunan Turanci, sunan a rubutunsu, da abincin a Turanci. Sanya waɗannan kalmomi a jerin abincinku. Duniya na ci gaba da wucewa; dakata ko bincika idan kuna son dubawa.
Nemo ƙasa ko abinci — misali India, biryani, Japan
Shahararren abinci ɗaya kowace ƙasa — jerin gwanon yana zagaye duk duniya.
Tebur ɗaya, daga farko har ƙarshe.
Ku kalli tebur tun daga zama har zuwa An biya — matakai da launuka iri ɗaya da ma’aikatanku ke gani a manhajar.
Sanya tebur a Akwai mutum da zarar baƙi sun zauna. Ƙara abinci, zaɓi girma, ƙara abubuwan ƙari, kuma rubuta bayani ga kicin — a nan kan tebur.
Zaɓi girma ɗaya; ƙara ƙarin zaɓi har zuwa iyakar da kuka saita.
“Rage yaji” yana tafiya tare da abincin da ya shafa.
Tikiti ɗaya ga kowane sashen kicin
Tura oda kuma kowane sashe yana samun abincinsa kawai — da lamba ta kowace rana, da tebur, mai sabis da kowane bayani. Ba farashi ko kaɗan: kicin yana dafawa, teburin ciniki yana karɓar kuɗi.
Tura, kuma tikitin yana bugawa a sashen da ya dace — babu wanda zai ɗauka.
Kicin yana ganin abin da za a dafa yanzu

A allon kicin tikiti suna tafiya Sabo → Ana girkawa → Ya shirya da taɓawa ɗaya. Tsofaffin tikiti suna ƙara zafin launi, “A dafa yanzu” yana ƙirga kowane abinci da ke jira, kuma babban abinci zai iya jira har sai an tura na farko.
Karɓi biya ta kowace hanya da baƙo ya biya

Tsabar kuɗi da canjin da za a mayar, UPI da adadin kuɗi tuni a cikin QR, biyan wani ɓangare, ko bashi a littafin bashin abokin ciniki. Raba ta abu, ta kujera ko daidai. Tebur ba ya zama babu kowa sai an biya lissafinsa.
Ana rubuta tukuici shi kaɗai — ba a taɓa haɗa shi da sayarwa ba.
Rufe yini da za ku amince da shi

Ƙirga aljihun kuɗi bisa kuɗin farawa, tsabar kuɗin da aka karɓa, tukuici da tsabar kuɗin da aka fitar — ana bayyana gibi ko rara. Buga takardar canjin aiki, sannan buɗe rahoton yini ta ma’aikaci, nau’in oda, sa’a da abinci, tare da sokewa, abincin kyauta da tukuici.
Abin da ake tsammani a aljihun kuɗi

An gina shi don hidima ta gaske.
Sauye-sauyen da ke faruwa a kowane abincin rana — ana gudanar da su a fili, tare da adana wane, yaushe da dalili.
Baƙi suna canza tebur — oda da mintocinta suna tafiya tare da su. Teburori biyu, lissafi ɗaya.
Da dalili, an dafa ko ba a dafa ba, da wanda ya amince. Kicin yana samun takardar sokewa.
Abincin kyauta yana zama a lissafi a ₹ 0, da dalili da wanda ya amince.

Farashi mafi tsada a ɗakin AC; jerin abincin karin kumallo da farashin lokacin rangwame bisa agogo.

Sayarwa ta ma’aikaci, nau’in oda, sa’a da abinci — tare da jerin sokewa, abincin kyauta da tukuici.
Jerin abincinku, a shirye cikin mintoci.
Saita teburin cinikinku kuma zaɓi jerin abinci na farawa mai hotuna — sannan canza sunaye, farashi da lambobi zuwa naku. Kyauta don saukewa daga khaynjo.com.
Jerin abinci na farawa na Khaynjo
Abincin duniya — na Japan, Mexico, Italiya, Indiya, Thailand da ƙari — kowane abinci da hotonsa.
Shayi, kofi, abubuwan sha masu sanyi, kayan burodi da abun ciye-ciye — a shirye don gidan shayi mai teburin ciniki.
Cikakkiyar ma’ajiyar hotuna ta jama’a — zaɓi hoto don kowane abinci da kuka ƙara.
Intanet ya katse. Teburin ciniki bai tsaya ba.

Oda, tikitin kicin, lissafi da littafin yini suna zaune a na’urorinku. Idan intanet ya katse a tsakiyar abincin rana, babu abin da ke jiran sa a gidan abincinku — kuma babu asusu a wurinmu da za ku shiga.

Littafin yini: an adana kowane lissafi a wannan na’ura

Ƙarfin manhaja ba shi ne abin da muke sayarwa ba. Gudanar da duk Khaynjo a na’urorinku ba tare da kuɗi ba — babu wani abu da aka kulle sai an sayi tsari.
Falo, kicin, lissafi, rufe yini, rahotanni — cikakkiyar manhaja.
